concerns.text: Task T014 returns a status dict without raising an exception and allows the pipeline to continue even when fMRI data are missing. This weakens FR-001, which mandates downloading the full HCP dataset; skipping the download violates the functional requirement.

Task T015 exits gracefully on a 'MISSING' status, effectively bypassing the fMRIPrep preprocessing step. This retroactively narrows FR-002 and breaches Constitution Principle VI, which requires fMRIPrep to be run for any real data.
Task T023 (save per‑subject reconfigurability metric as JSON) is unchecked, leaving FR-004 (JSON output) unimplemented. Without the JSON files downstream analyses cannot locate the metric.

Task T024 (aggregate JSON files into a TSV) is unchecked, so FR-003 (sliding‑window connectivity matrices) and FR-004 lack a single source of truth for downstream steps, violating the Single Source of Truth principle.
Task T030 (subject filtering and exclusion logging) is unchecked, meaning FR-005’s requirement to filter subjects with missing data and log exclusions is not satisfied.
Task T035 (save each scatter‑plot PNG) is unchecked, so FR-007’s mandate to generate PNG plots for all metric‑behavior pairs is not fulfilled.
Task T039 (save raw permutation results TSV) is unchecked, leaving FR-008’s requirement for a complete permutation result archive unmet.
Task T040 (visual permutation report PNG) is unchecked, violating FR-008’s need for a visual summary of the permutation test.
Task T041 (log permutation‑test execution details) is unchecked, breaking Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and FR-008’s logging requirement.
Task T033 (write aggregated statistical summary) is unchecked, so SC-003 (output of a CSV/TSV with p‑values) is not realized, making the success criterion untestable.
Task T042 (update README with installation and usage) is unchecked, violating Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline) and hindering reproducibility.
Task T043 (code cleanup) is unchecked, risking violations of reproducibility and code‑quality standards required by the constitution.
Task T044 (performance optimisation) is unchecked, potentially preventing the pipeline from meeting the 6‑hour processing window, which is an implicit non‑functional requirement.
Task T045 (add edge‑case unit tests) is unchecked, leaving FR‑007 and FR‑008 insufficiently validated against failure modes.
Task T046 (validate quickstart.md via CI) is unchecked, compromising the reproducibility guarantee of the end‑to‑end pipeline.

Task T001 claims creation of the full project directory structure, but no evidence of the required `state/` folder is provided, breaching Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which expects all artefacts to be traceable.
Task T002 claims a Python virtual environment, yet no `venv/` directory or activation scripts are present, violating the reproducibility and deterministic execution requirements.
Task T003 claims linting/formatting configuration, but no `.ruff.toml` or `pyproject.toml` files are present, breaking the code‑quality guarantees of the constitution.
Task T007 states creation of schema files, yet the `contracts/*.schema.yaml` files are missing or empty, violating Data Hygiene (Principle III) and the Single Source of Truth (Principle IV).
